name: Ogeechee tupelo
desc: Ogeechee tupelo (Nyssa ogeche): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Nyssa ogeche, commonly referred to as Ogeechee tupelo, white tupelo, river lime, ogeechee lime tree, sour gum or wild lime is a deciduous tree endemic to the southeastern United States.
